name: glitch scan into ring-drawn logomark
looks: A beat of near-black holds on a single small accent dot, then a horizontal scan-line glitch streaks across the dark. Out of the glitch, a set of concentric rings draws outward and resolves into the clean outline of a single lower-case letter, glowing, before crossfading into the crisp brand mark.
build: A black field holds a single pulsing DOM dot; the glitch is a thin horizontal band jittering position and opacity for a few frames. The ring reveal is concentric SVG circles, each tracing an arc of the letterform's outline on strokeDashoffset, staggered outward-in and fading to a flat glow (the noise-dissolve-logomark mechanic, with rings standing in for scattered points); it crossfades to the crisp DOM mark in the last 0.1 s.
sound: A short digital glitch burst, a shimmer as the rings resolve into a soft hit as the mark completes.
prompt: Hold a beat of near-black around one small glowing point, let a scan-line glitch streak through, then have a set of concentric rings draw outward out of the glitch until they resolve into a glowing outline of the brand's mark, crossfading to its crisp final form.
